title: Staff Security Engineer, Abuse Control
description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) is Stripe’s rapid-response technical defense and control incubator. When urgent abuse vectors emerge, ACE uses real-world attacker telemetry to prototype, test, and deploy software safeguards before vulnerabilities can be exploited at scale. We partner closely with Fraud, Risk, Abuse Research, and Product Engineering to run rigorous experiments that balance effective risk mitigation with legitimate user activity and conversion. Operating as both a strike team and an incubator, ACE builds automated regression suites to prevent threats from recurring and transfers mature controls to long-term product owners across Stripe. What you’ll do As an Abuse Control Engineer on the ACE team, you will design, prototype, and incubate technical defenses that safeguard Stripe’s financial ecosystem against complex, cross-cutting abuse vectors. When emerging threat patterns reveal weaknesses in Stripe products, ACE rapidly builds and experiments with technical safeguards. Guided by empirical evidence and Stripe’s Fraud Taxonomy 3.0 (FT3) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into precise technical control requirements, such as API rate limits, step-up challenges, parameter validation, and pre-debit holds. You will run experiments to evaluate risk reduction against the impact on legitimate user conversion, carefully balancing security and product velocity. You will manage controls through a structured incubation lifecycle, build automated regression suites to prevent threats from recurring, and partner with product engineering teams to transfer mature, long-term defenses. Responsibilities Rapid control prototyping: Design, prototype, and deploy technical controls across API, protocol, and product boundaries to address high-impact abuse vectors. Evidence-based technical requirements: Translate empirical attacker evidence and FT3 threat research from Abuse Research, Fraud, and Security teams into precise technical abuse requirements and control specifications. Control co-design: Collaborate with teams across Stripe to design resilient, secure controls across payments, onboarding, identity, and Connect surfaces. Risk experimentation: Run rigorous experiments and A/B tests to measure risk reduction against the impact on legitimate user conversion, optimizing controls to minimize friction while neutralizing threats. Regression testing: Build comprehensive regression test suites and automated attack simulations with Abuse Research to ensure mitigated abuse vectors do not recur. Stakeholder management: Execute ACE’s incubation model by defining handoff criteria, operational documentation, timelines, and target dates for transferring successful controls to product teams. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 10+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, application security, or anti-abuse engineering in a high-scale production environment. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. A strong software development background, with proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or a similar production programming language, as well as advanced SQL skills for analyzing system telemetry. Experience using frontier AI models for software development, learning, and analysis. Hands-on experience building API-level safeguards, rate-limiting frameworks, authentication or authorization checks, or input-validation controls. Experience with automated testing frameworks, including writing unit, integration, and regression tests for critical backend software. Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across security, product, and platform teams to drive technical outcomes. Preferred qualifications A track record of designing and executing A/B tests, evaluating control efficacy, and balancing security safeguards against user conversion friction. Expertise in threat modeling, secure systems architecture, and modern application-security design principles. Familiarity with established threat frameworks, such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&CK, and experience applying adversary kill-chain analysis to build resilient defenses. Knowledge of financial fraud vectors, threat-actor tactics, techniques, and procedures, and attacker infrastructure, including account takeover, card testing, and credential stuffing. Hands-on experience with large-scale data-processing platforms, such as Databricks, Trino, or PySpark, to monitor and measure control performance across distributed systems. Experience incubating software features, establishing clear operational handoff criteria, and transitioning ownership to partner engineering teams.

Own reliability and operational excellence for the deployment platform. Own the deployment notification and event-publishing architecture — designing the event schema, durability model, and integration contracts that downstream systems rely on for observability and automation. Collaborate across Core Change Management. Set the technical bar. description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform. Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives: Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration). Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences. Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations. These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch. What you’ll do We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership. In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program. Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries. Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices. Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own. Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment. Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience Preferred Qualifications Background in product management or product operations Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills An innovative mindset with the ability to drive exceptional workplace services and operational improvements Preferred qualifications: Proficiency in Google Suite, Slack and Jira A clear willingness to take a hands-on approach and dive into the details Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners and translate enterprise strategy into effective local execution. Databricksは、お客様がAIプラットフォームを活用して、世界で最も難しいなデータに関する課題を解決できるよう支援することをミッションとしています。デリバリーソリューションアーキテクト（DSA）は、この重要なミッションにおいて、セールスおよびフィールド・エンジニアリングチームと協力し、お客様のDatabricksプラットフォームの導入と利用拡大を加速させる重要な役割を担います。DSAとして、お客様がすでに導入を決定したDatabricksのワークロードについて、お客様がプラットフォームから最大限の価値と投資対効果を得られるよう、技術的な指導とサポートを提供し、お客様の成功を確実にします。特に、複雑な課題を抱えるお客様に対して、より重点的かつ技術的な責任を持って支援を行います。 このポジションは、技術とビジネスの両面を兼ね備えたハイブリッドな役割です。担当するお客様とユースケースにおいて、成長を推進します。ビジネス面では、お客様の意思決定者と関係を構築し、他の専門チームと連携しながら、Databricksが実行できる計画や戦略を策定・推進します。技術面ではDatabricksの全製品における、お客様導入後の技術的なリーダーとなります。組織内のあらゆるレベルの人々と、技術的な専門知識を活かしてコミュニケーションをとる能力が求められます。 あなたがもたらす影響 : 戦略的アカウントにおける複雑なユースケースおよび複数のワークストリーム全体で、技術的な実行戦略を定義し、影響を与える。 お客様のテクニカルリードやアーキテクトにとって信頼される技術アドバイザーとなり、アーキテクチャの議論をリードし、技術的な意思決定をガイドする。 パフォーマンス、コスト、信頼性、長期的なニーズのバランスを取りながら、安全かつガバナンスの効いたスケーラブルなDatabricksアーキテクチャを設計する。 お客様の成果を加速させる実用的なソリューション、プロトタイプ、再利用可能な技術資産を構築・実証する。 プラットフォームの成熟度とスケーリングのニーズを予測し、セキュリティ、ガバナンス、運用の卓越性に関するベストプラクティスを確立する。 アーキテクチャに影響を与え、デリバリーの障害を取り除き、技術的な実行をビジネス成果に結びつけることで、プラットフォームの採用と利用を促進する。 Databricks、お客様、導入チームと連携し、リソースの調整、リスク管理、デリバリーの加速を行う。 同僚を指導し、組織全体で活用できる再利用可能な技術ガイダンス、フレームワーク、およびイネーブルメントに貢献する。 必要な条件/経験: ソリューションアーキテクト、ソリューションエンジニアリング、技術コンサルティング、プロフェッショナルサービス、データエンジニアリング、または関連する技術的役割における5年以上の経験 複雑な顧客のユースケースや複数のワークストリーム全体で、技術戦略やアーキテクチャに影響を与えた経験 Python、SQL、または類似の言語における高いコーディング能力と、技術的ソリューションの構築、デバッグ、検証を行う能力 分散データシステム、データエンジニアリング、分析、データウェアハウジング、AI/ML、および最新のクラウドアーキテクチャに関する深い理解 安全でガバナンスが効き、スケーラブルかつ本番環境に対応したデータソリューションを設計した経験 title: Accounting Data & Technology Manager
location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
description: GAQ327R291 Accounting Data & Technology Manager About the Role We are building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are seeking an Accounting Data & Technology Manager to join our Global Accounting team and serve as the architect of the redesign of our accounting processes by building automation solutions and managing data pipelines that power our global accounting organization. You will serve as the accounting team's S/4HANA expert — the person who ensures our in-flight SAP implementation reflects best practice rather than a lift-and-shift of how we operate in NetSuite today. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between our team's subject matter experts, our technology solutions, and the business data needed to support accounting operations. In addition to SAP ownership, this role will build purposeful, reliable solutions on top of the Databricks platform and Finance Datalake to accelerate global accounting operations. During the SAP implementation, you will work alongside our system integrator to challenge design decisions, identify where SAP's native capabilities can replace manual workarounds, and ensure the accounting team is building on the right foundation from day one. Post go-live, the role transitions to continuous improvement — owning automation opportunities, streamlining close processes as SAP capabilities evolve, and ensuring Databricks is getting progressively more value out of the platform over time rather than running it as a static system. This is a rare opportunity to shape a major ERP platform from day one at one of the world's fastest-growing technology companies, with the autonomy to define how SAP works for accounting at Databricks — and how it connects to the most advanced data and AI platform in the market. What You'll Do SAP Implementation Governance (Near-Term) Work alongside our system integrator as the accounting team's internal SAP S/4HANA subject matter expert throughout the implementation program. Challenge design decisions and configuration choices — ensuring they reflect SAP best practice rather than replicating current-state NetSuite processes. Identify where SAP's native capabilities (standard workflows, automated postings, embedded analytics, Fiori apps) can replace manual workarounds and custom development. Own the accounting team's requirements, testing, and sign-off for SAP configuration across core FICO areas — general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and close management. Partner with our system integrator, IT and Finance Transformation to ensure data migration, chart of accounts design, and master data governance meet accounting's needs. Continuous Improvement & Optimization (Post Go-Live) Own the SAP continuous improvement roadmap for accounting — identifying automation opportunities, process simplifications, and new SAP capabilities as they are released. Streamline close processes within SAP — driving adoption of native automation, reducing cycle time, eliminating manual steps, and improving data quality with each close cycle. Monitor system performance and proactively address configuration issues, data quality gaps, and process bottlenecks. Collaborate with Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Accounts Payable, Revenue, and Procurement to ensure SAP configuration supports end-to-end finance processes — not just accounting in isolation. Ensure SOX-relevant system controls (automated, access and change management controls) within SAP are properly configured, documented, and operating effectively. SAP × Databricks Platform Integration Own the design and governance of how SAP accounting data flows into the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform — ensuring clean, timely, and well-structured data for financial reporting, analytics, and AI use cases. Partner with Data Engineering and Finance Systems to define the SAP-to-Databricks integration architecture — including extraction patterns, data models, and refresh cadences that support close timelines and ad-hoc analysis. Identify opportunities to leverage Databricks' AI and automation capabilities on top of SAP data — such as anomaly detection on journal entries, predictive accruals, automated reconciliation matching, and natural-language reporting via Genie. Serve as the accounting team's voice in shaping how Databricks' own platform is used for internal finance operations — ensuring the company is a best-practice reference customer for its own technology. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications 8+ years of progressive experience in accounting systems, ERP administration, or finance technology — with deep, hands-on SAP S/4HANA FICO experience. Demonstrated expertise in SAP S/4HANA configuration across core accounting areas: general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and financial close and consolidation. Experience participating in or leading at least one full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementation — ideally on the business/functional side rather than purely technical. Strong understanding of accounting close processes, U.S. GAAP, and how ERP configuration decisions impact financial reporting. Experience with SAP master data governance, chart of accounts design, and configuration documentation. SOX experience — understanding how system controls, access management, and segregation of duties operate within SAP. Ability to translate between accounting business requirements and SAP technical configuration — comfortable working with both accountants and technical consultants. Strong communication skills — able to articulate system design trade-offs to senior finance leadership clearly and concisely. High ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently without constant direction. Preferred Qualifications SAP S/4HANA certification (e.g., SAP Certified Application Associate — Financial Accounting). Experience with SAP Central Finance, SAP Analytics Cloud, or SAP BTP. CPA, CA, or equivalent professional accounting certification. Experience working at a high-growth technology or SaaS company. Prior experience working on SAP implementations. Familiarity with NetSuite (helpful for understanding the current-state processes being migrated). Experience with Databricks or other data platforms. Public accounting experience (Big 4 or equivalent). Why This Role Shape SAP from day one — you are not inheriting a legacy system. You will define how SAP works for accounting at Databricks, with the authority to ensure it is built right the first time. Challenge, don't just configure — this role exists specifically to push back on "that's how we've always done it" and ensure the implementation reflects what SAP can do, not what NetSuite did. Own the platform long-term — this is not a project role. Post go-live, you will own continuous improvement, automation, and system operations — ensuring Databricks gets progressively more value from SAP over time. Build on the Databricks platform — this is not a typical ERP role. You will define how SAP connects to the most advanced data and AI platform in the market, shaping how accounting data is used for reporting, analytics, and AI-driven automation. Few finance roles anywhere offer this combination. Work at the intersection of accounting and technology — partner with a world-class finance team, a leading SI, and Databricks' own engineering organization to build something exceptional. Grow your career — gain deep exposure to global accounting operations, finance transformation, and enterprise technology at one of the world's fastest-growing companies. title: Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable
location: Austin, Texas; Denver, Colorado; Portland, Oregon
description: GAQ327R240 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale. Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth. The impact you will have: Own the Global AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers. Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes. Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership. Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses. Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances. Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations. What we look for: Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting. Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance. Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies. Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework. Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules. M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential. The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus. description: GAQ427R224 We're hiring an AI Automation Engineer to build the next generation of IT automations to improve the employee experience at Databricks. The goal isn't to automate existing workflows the same way we've done it for the past decade. It's to reimagine how employees interact with IT through intelligent, contextual, and increasingly agentic experiences and to do it on Databricks. What you will do Build AI agents and automations: Design, deploy, and run AI agents that support all of our employees. The agents interpret natural-language requests, gather context, select tools, execute actions, and communicate outcomes. Maintain MCP servers across our AI tools portfolio. Build agentic workflows that decompose goals into steps, handle failures, pause for human approval as needed, and resume their workflows. Ground agents in trusted internal knowledge (policies, runbooks, system documentation, SOPs, etc). Turn high-volume support CUJs into self-service experiences: Identify repetitive, high-friction IT interactions and convert them into reliable AI automation experiences. Instrument AI automations with logs, metrics, and feedback loops. Design and implement AI automations with identity governance, tools RBAC, human-in-the-loop approvals where applicable, audit trails, and failure handling. Create shared automation infrastructure (credential vaults, event ingestion, scheduling, approval workflows, cache/state stores) that other teams can build on. title: Deployment Strategist
description: About the Team The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." Role Description As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset. The impact you will have C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. What we look for Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions. Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. title: Director of Engineering (Data Infrastructure)
description: (P-1490) Databricks processes petabytes of data and billions of transaction events daily - every cluster launch, every query executed, every dollar billed flows through infrastructure that must never fail. When we process billions in billing transactions with 99.999% accuracy requirements, when we ingest terabytes per second across 100+ regions, when a five-minute outage costs millions in revenue and customer trust - infrastructure isn't just important, it's existential. The next phase of our growth demands disaster recovery systems that prove reliability rather than hope for it, testing frameworks that catch production-scale problems before deployment, correctness guarantees that make billing errors structurally impossible, and automation that scales operations sublinearly with growth. In this leadership opportunity, you will build the data infrastructure organization that makes Databricks' continued growth possible. You'll establish foundational teams in Bengaluru owning the bedrock systems that guarantee billing correctness, operational resilience, and zero-downtime recovery across our entire monetization stack, alongside multi-region data ingestion, developer platforms, and deployment automation that eliminate friction at petabyte scale. This isn't about maintaining what exists; it's about architecting the infrastructure that enables Databricks to scale while reducing operational burden. At Databricks, our mission is to simplify and democratize data and AI so that every organization can put them to work. Design is central to that mission. We turn powerful, complex technology into clear, accessible, and trustworthy experiences that open advanced capabilities to all kinds of users. The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for establishing and developing deep, long-term alliances with the world’s most important technology companies in the Data & AI ecosystem. We focus on CEO-priority partnerships that have the potential to be highly impactful to the Databricks business. As the Director, Strategic Partnerships, you will be a key team member structuring strategic partnerships with leading cloud hyperscalers and Neoclouds. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders including product, engineering, sales, and finance to develop and optimize strategic partnerships, with an emphasis on growth and business economics. You will develop relationships with our strategic partners’ decision makers and identify opportunities for win-win collaboration. This job is fast-paced, cross-functional, and requires strong communication, prioritization, organization, and presentation skills. You must have deep subject matter expertise in cloud computing consumption-based business models and technologies. You also must have at least 7+ years of business development experience negotiating bespoke, non-programmatic deals. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, finance, sales, and marketing stakeholders to develop strategic partnership objectives. Build deep relationships with stakeholders in partner organizations to align their business objectives for win-win outcomes. Influence product and engineering decisions by providing data-driven insights and qualitative analysis supporting the partnership opportunity. Develop KPIs to define, measure, and drive success of partnerships. Work closely with the VP, Strategic Partnerships and Databricks executive team to scale thought leadership for new opportunities. What we look for: Minimum of 7+ years of experience in business development, corporate development, or consulting. Proven track record negotiating highly bespoke commercial arrangements with C-suite level counterparties. Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in developing first-principles and data-driven business cases and strategic plans using a variety of tools. Strong understanding of GTM and sales motions that drive partnership success. Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of distilling complex analyses into clear messaging for executives and stakeholders. Strong judgment, ownership, and cross-functional leadership. Ability to drive deal processes autonomously as the deal lead. Strong bias for action mindset with the ability to make an impact in a face-paced environment. MBA degree or a related field; or equivalent business experience. title: Director, Technical Marketing
description: MKTQ427R50 As the Director of Technical Marketing at Databricks, you will lead and scale the team responsible for explaining Databricks products, and what you can do with them, at scale to technical buyers and practitioners (from data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to solutions architects, platform teams, security engineers, and application developers). You will own the strategy and execution of technical content in written and video form, demos, workshops, launch storytelling, and outbound evangelism that drives technical mindshare, consideration, product adoption, and ultimately pipeline. In the era of agentic marketing and AEO/GEO, your team will increasingly produce content designed to educate both humans and agents alike. You will also play an outsized role in programming the technical content for key Databricks events, such as the Data + AI Summit and Data + AI World Tour, among others. Reporting to the SVP of Product & Solutions Marketing, you will manage a team of 6+ Technical Marketing Managers (growing) and serve as the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and the broader technical community. This role expands the traditional TMM charter to include a stronger outbound evangelism dimension, becoming a visible, trusted technical voice externally through social media, YouTube, conferences, and the data practitioner ecosystem while continuing to own the core technical content engine that powers Summit, World Tour, workshops, and field enablement. The impact you will have: First 6 months: Assess the current TMM team's strengths, gaps, and capacity; establish a clear operating model with defined ownership areas (product coverage, content types, GEO) and a quarterly planning cadence. Own and deliver the technical content agenda for Data + AI World Tour and/or the next major Tier 1 event, achieving ≥4.5/5.0 average session ratings and measurable pipeline contribution. Launch or significantly expand at least 2 new outbound evangelism motions (e.g., a YouTube series architecture, a technical social media cadence, or a creator/influencer engagement program) that grow Databricks' external technical reach by ≥25%. Build an AI-powered publishing engine that enables the TMM team to scale content faster, leveraging AI assistance for content creation and publishing. Establish yourself as a credible external technical voice, publishing 3+ original technical pieces (blogs, videos, or talks) and representing Databricks at 2+ external events or podcasts. First 12 months: Scale the TMM team to meet growing demand across an expanding set of technical personas (solutions architects, platform engineers, security teams, data scientists, analysts, app developers) driven by the 2026+ product surface (Lakebase, Genie, Lakewatch, Agent Bricks, Omnigent). Work with Databricks Field Engineering and FDE (Forward-Deployed Engineering) to capture repeatable product use cases into a Solutions Library, building a motion to scale capture and marketing of these use cases for learning across the entire community. Build and operationalize a "1 launch → many assets" content engine that converts every major product launch into persona-specific learning journeys (demos, workshops, blogs, videos, social). Grow Databricks' YouTube and social technical content reach by 2x, with a series-based content architecture targeting key personas at multiple depth levels. Drive measurable contribution to AEO/GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ensuring Databricks is cited by default in AI answer engines for key buyer questions. First 18–24 months: Establish Databricks as the default place every technical practitioner learns data + AI, measured by YouTube subscriber growth (target: 300K+), technical content engagement, and Free Edition activation rates tied to content. Build a formal Databricks Creators program that turns independent creator reach into co-owned, accurate, early-access content across new product areas. Develop the TMM team into a recognized center of excellence — with clear career paths, a strong hiring bar, and a reputation as one of the best technical marketing teams in enterprise software. What we look for: 10+ years of experience in technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, field engineering, or a related technical field in enterprise software / SaaS / cloud. 3+ years of people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. Deep technical fluency in data, AI/ML, and cloud platforms, comfortable building demos and engaging credibly with data engineers, data scientists, solutions architects, and other technical practitioners across the data + AI ecosystem. Demonstrated outbound evangelism skills, including a visible external presence through conference speaking, technical blogging, YouTube/video content, or social media thought leadership. Experience owning technical content strategy for major product launches and flagship events (e.g., user conferences, world tours). Strong cross-functional influence with a proven ability to partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Field Engineering, and Sales to align on priorities and deliver integrated GTM. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for multiple audiences. Preferred: Experience with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, Apache Spark, or related open-source data technologies. Experience building or scaling a YouTube channel, podcast, or technical content program for practitioner audiences. Familiarity with GEO / AI answer engine optimization strategies. Experience with technical community building, creator programs, or influencer engagement across practitioner audiences. Track record of building technical content that drives measurable pipeline and product adoption. Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We are seeking a strategic, operationally strong Director, Travel & Expense to lead and modernize our global travel, expense, and corporate spend ecosystem. This leader will drive a digital-first, highly scalable program that improves the employee experience while strengthening governance, compliance, and financial discipline across a fast-growing global organization. This role is ideal for a builder who can define future-state strategy while also leading hands-on execution, operational rigor, and measurable outcomes. The successful candidate will partner closely across Finance, Procurement, IT, HR, Security, and Operations to create a seamless and future-ready T&E model. The impact you will have: Lead the transformation of the T&E program into a modern, automated, digital-first experience, including AI-enabled workflows, touchless expense processing, automated audit controls, and intelligent policy enforcement. Create a frictionless employee experience across booking, expense submission, approvals, reimbursements, and support while simplifying processes and reducing manual work. Build a scalable global T&E roadmap that balances agility, governance, employee experience, and operational efficiency, with clear KPIs, dashboards, and change management to support adoption. Oversee global business travel operations across air, hotel, ground transportation, meetings, and traveler support, while shaping regional travel strategies for a distributed workforce. Manage travel partners and supplier relationships to improve service levels, optimize spend, and support evolving business needs. Partner with Security and HR to strengthen traveler safety, duty of care, and crisis response capabilities. Lead enterprise expense reimbursement and corporate card programs with a focus on automation, compliance, scalability, and employee experience. Implement intelligent expense capabilities such as auto-generated reports, AI auditing, receipt automation, and policy-driven workflows, while simplifying approvals and accelerating reimbursement cycles. Partner closely with AP, Payroll, and Finance Operations to streamline end-to-end financial processes. Own the T&E technology ecosystem, including platforms such as Emburse, Egencia, Ramp, Brex, AppZen, and corporate card integrations; partner with IT and Finance Systems on integrations, APIs, and analytics. Ensure strong policy governance, financial controls, audit readiness, and compliance with global tax, regulatory, data privacy, and regional travel requirements. Build and lead a high-performing global team, develop leadership bench strength, and influence cross-functional stakeholders in a complex, fast-moving environment. What we look for: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Supply Chain, Hospitality, Information Systems, or a related field. 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Travel, Expense, Procurement, Finance Operations, Shared Services, or related functions. Proven success leading T&E transformation, automation, or digital modernization initiatives in high-growth or fast-paced organizations. Experience leading global or multinational T&E programs and managing regional operations and cross-border transformation efforts. Strong operational leadership with the ability to translate strategy into scalable execution. Deep expertise in T&E platforms, workflow automation, corporate card programs, and expense technologies. Strong understanding of AI-enabled operations, process redesign, and scalable service delivery models. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills, with the ability to lead through ambiguity and evolving business priorities. Experience leading global or multinational T&E programs. MBA, CPA, CTP, or related certification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, automation, or digital transformation experience strongly preferred. title: Director, Web Marketing
description: MKTQ327R30 Databricks is hiring an experienced web leader to grow and scale the function globally, as the company continues its hyper-growth and leadership in the Data and AI space. You will be an essential member of the marketing leadership team, drawing on all of our internal resources to bring our marketing strategy to our digital audiences — and increasingly to a new kind of audience: the AI agents and assistants that now read, interpret, and act on the web on behalf of the people we're trying to reach. You will ultimately be measured on your ability to develop a cohesive portfolio of web properties built for scale, personalization, and this next era of how people and machines discover and evaluate companies. Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you will build and oversee a product team focused on executing and iterating on marketing priorities. The ideal candidate has held a senior digital leadership role in a high-performing marketing organization at a company experiencing rapid growth. You have operated at scale in a global environment while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset and approach. You have excellent fundamentals, strong presence, and the ability to build a strong team. Just as important, you have a point of view on where the web is going, and know how to build for AI-driven search, answer engines, and autonomous agents. The impact you will have: Transform Databricks' web properties into outstanding destinations using a modern development approach and current technologies, built to serve both human visitors and the AI agents and assistants that now consume and act on web content. Put AI to work inside the function, using it to automate and accelerate web production, QA, localization, testing, and routine optimization so the team spends its time on strategy and craft rather than repetitive execution. Establish a strategy for how Databricks evolves and scales its web presence with the business across segments, products, industries, partners, and languages — and for how our content stays legible, accurate, and well-represented as AI systems increasingly mediate discovery. Monitor and optimize web traffic and coordinate with global teams to ensure the success of both worldwide brand awareness and demand generation efforts in every market. Implement a robust testing and personalization program using all available tools to create creative, tailored digital experiences that increase conversion. Ensure our web properties are structured for machine readability — clean information architecture, structured data, and content that both people and agents can parse and trust — so Databricks is accurately represented wherever our audiences are researching. Leverage data on product usage and website analytics, working directly with the broader marketing team to develop strategies that improve growth. Manage internal and external partners and vendors, and serve as the in-house expert for web strategy across the organization. Strengthen the cross-departmental collaboration required to support and develop digital experiences for all of our audiences, through established processes and frameworks for high-velocity execution. Build and lead a growing, globally distributed team, ensuring both team and personal growth. What we look for: 10+ years on a high-performing web marketing or development team. 5+ years managing a team. Depth in the technical aspects of running a website: analytics, UX, technical and content SEO, and information architecture. A point of view on the future of the web — AI-driven search and answer engines, structured/machine-readable content, and designing for AI agents and assistants as a genuine audience, not a novelty. A track record of adopting AI tools and agents to streamline web workflows. Experience growing and scaling a function to meet the needs of team members, other departments, and contractors. A strategic partner and agreement builder who helps other teams translate requirements into customer-centric web experiences. Have led a large-scale, international website refresh or rebuild. Experience with web optimization and testing frameworks, and ideally with modern composable/headless architectures. You will own how marketing translates into pipeline and revenue for Mexico—turning customer insights, sales priorities, and global programs into local, full-funnel demand. description: GAQ327R292 We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for a Global Consolidations Manager to join our Global Accounting team based in India. This is a foundational hire - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live. This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks. The impact you will have: Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint. Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review. Build and own SAP Group Reporting expertise - serve as the accounting team's subject matter expert on SAP's consolidation engine, including configuration, period-end processing, and ongoing optimisation. Execute intercompany accounting across all entities - ensuring balances are reconciled, disputes are resolved within the close window, and elimination entries are complete and accurate. Perform monthly consolidation flux analysis, identifying and clearly articulating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Own FX translation and revaluation accounting - functional currency determination, translation adjustments, and CTA reconciliation across all international entities. Support new entity stand-up - partner with Tax, Legal, and International Accounting to establish consolidation processes, intercompany agreements, and reporting structures for new international selling entities as Databricks expands. Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit on consolidation, intercompany, and multi-GAAP reporting matters. Champion compliance with SOX controls across the consolidation process. Drive AI and automation adoption across consolidation workflows - including automated intercompany matching, elimination entry generation, and reconciliation tooling leveraging the Databricks platform. Partner with the Senior Manager, Close & Consolidation (US) to ensure seamless handoff and time-zone coverage for the most time-sensitive part of the global close. What we look for: BA/BS Degree with a focus in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance. 10+ years progressive accounting experience, with at least 5+ years specifically in consolidation, intercompany accounting, or international accounting within a US multinational framework. A Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA equivalent certification is mandatory. Deep understanding of US GAAP consolidation requirements (ASC 810, ASC 830) and working knowledge of IFRS consolidation standards (IFRS 10, IAS 21). Multi-GAAP reporting experience is strongly preferred. SAP S/4HANA experience required - specifically SAP Group Reporting or SAP BPC. Candidates with implementation experience will be prioritized. Proven experience managing intercompany accounting at scale - reconciliation, netting, dispute resolution, and elimination across a multi-entity, multi-currency environment. Experience with FX translation, functional currency assessment, and CTA accounting across complex international structures. Proven track record driving automation and process improvement in consolidation or close operations. Experience supporting external audits and SOX compliance in a consolidation context. Proven experience partnering with remote teams across different geographic areas, including with US-based accounting leadership, and the flexibility to support close timelines that span US Pacific Time hours. title: Incident Manager
description: Incident Manager US Remote CSQ127R151 At Databricks, we are passionate about empowering data teams to tackle the world’s most challenging problems — from bringing the next mode of transportation to reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We achieve this by building and operating the world’s best data and AI infrastructure platform, enabling our customers to leverage deep data insights and enhance their business. Founded by engineers — and customer-obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. As an Incident Manager, you will lead Databricks’ most critical production incidents while providing clear, accurate, and timely communication to customers, executives, and engineers. You’ll serve as both incident commander and reliability engineer; orchestrating multi-team responses, driving real-time status updates, and partnering with engineering to analyze and prevent failures. Your work will ensure Databricks maintains not only technical resilience but also customer and stakeholder confidence during high-impact events. This role combines operational leadership, technical systems knowledge, and exceptional communication skills. You will be at the intersection of engineering depth and operational clarity, ensuring that every major incident is managed with precision, transparency, and continuous improvement. The impact you will have here: Lead critical incidents — coordinate multi-disciplinary response efforts across Databricks’ cloud-based services to rapidly mitigate impact and restore operations. Drive technical root cause analysis and reliability improvements: collaborate with engineering teams to trace and document underlying causes across distributed systems, services, and data stores. Summarize key learnings, clearly communicate action items, and ensure that technical and procedural improvements are followed through. Own communications during incidents — deliver frequent, high-quality updates to internal stakeholders (executives, engineering leadership, support) and compose and publish customer-facing notifications that are accurate, timely, and empathetic. Mentor and train peers in both incident communication and technical response disciplines to raise the overall quality of Databricks’ incident response. What are we looking for: 5+ years of experience in incident management, site reliability engineering, or production operations supporting large-scale, cloud-native systems. Proven ability to lead and coordinate high-severity incidents, including identifying impact, isolating fault domains, and managing multi-team response efforts. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — including compute, networking, storage, and observability components. Deep expertise in log analysis and debugging: Familiarity with log aggregation and search tools (e.g., Datadog, Elasticsearch, Splunk, Cloud Logging, or OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience with observability systems — metrics, logging, and tracing frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, etc.). Proficiency in at least one major programming or scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash) for automating diagnostics, data collection, or analysis. Experience developing and maintaining incident playbooks and communication templates to ensure consistent, timely updates. Excellent contextual interpretation and writing skills, as well as the ability to effectively summarize and communicate to both technical and business audiences, are required. BS, Master's or other advanced degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or related Engineering field. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers. You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts. This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation. What You'll Do Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts. Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation. Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect. Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount. Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field. Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation. Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings. What We're Looking For Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers. Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety. Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring). Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations. Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly. A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them. Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal. Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed. Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus. Nice to Have Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space. Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical. Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap. Why This Role You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Lead Solutions Architect – MedTech (Strategic Account)
description: (FEQ128R42) The Role You will be the technical leader and lead architect for one of Databricks' most strategic global customers: a health technology company whose diagnostic, therapy, connected-care and consumer health products reach hundreds of millions of people every year. You will own the technical relationship and the Data + AI vision for a single complex enterprise that spans multiple business units, regions and regulatory regimes. The account is a large, Azure-first Data Intelligence Platform customer. It runs a portfolio of well over a hundred use cases across business units and global functions, delivered as a multi-year program in quarterly releases. You will set the technical direction for that program and turn it into an executable roadmap. You will work as one team with the Account Executive and a dedicated pod of Solutions Architects, specialists, Professional Services and partners. We are looking for a visionary who can see where Data + AI will take health technology, explain that clearly to executives and engineers alike, and bring a large, distributed group of people with them! The Impact You Will Have Own and drive the technical vision Define the customer's enterprise Data + AI vision with CxO and VP stakeholders, tied directly to business priorities. Be the executive suite's trusted advisor on platform strategy, build-vs-buy, responsible AI and regulated-industry governance. Show, don't tell: inspire CTOs, chief architects and engineering leaders with working examples, and build prototypes yourself when it matters. Lead the account pod technically: set direction for Solutions Architects, Specialist and Delivery SAs, Professional Services and partners, and coach them to raise the bar. Partner with the Account Executive on account strategy and consumption planning, owning technical strategy and path to value for every major initiative. Align pre-sales, delivery and partners so the customer sees one Databricks team, one plan and one escalation path, local to global. Lead discovery and solution design for strategic, high-risk deployments, driving each to production and measurable outcomes. Build lasting C-level, VP and Director relationships across IT, data & AI, R&D, Quality & Regulatory, Service, Operations and the business units. title: Lead Technical Enablement Specialist, Field Capability & Readiness
description: SLSQ227R703 About the Role The Field Engineering role is changing quickly. AI is changing how technical work gets done, products and customer needs are evolving faster, and the capabilities that distinguish an exceptional FE today will not be exactly the same ones that matter tomorrow. Databricks is looking for a Lead Technical Enablement Specialist to help define and build the capability engine for our global Field Engineering organization. You will shape how FEs build expertise, demonstrate readiness, share what they know, and apply their capabilities with customers. This role owns a portfolio, not a single program. That portfolio may include skills verification, technical validation, role-based readiness paths, practical challenges, and new approaches we have not yet imagined. Your job is to understand where the field is headed, identify the capabilities that will matter most, and turn that insight into experiences and systems that help FEs grow and perform. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build. You will work with FE leaders, product and technical communities, regional teams, enablement partners, HR, and internal platform teams to define what “field-ready” means and make it useful in the flow of work. You will have the opportunity to influence how a global technical organization develops - and to create programs that become part of how Databricks operates. The best person for this role is equal parts strategist, product thinker, builder, and operator. You can see around corners, create structure from ambiguity, earn trust with senior stakeholders, and turn an idea into something the field actually uses. You are energized by the possibility of using AI not only as a topic to teach, but as a catalyst to redesign how capability is built, measured, and scaled. What You'll Do Set the vision and roadmap for FE capability. Develop a clear point of view on how Databricks should build, demonstrate, recognize, and continuously evolve field expertise. Translate FE strategy, product priorities, customer needs, and the changing nature of technical work into a focused portfolio of investments. Own and evolve a portfolio of readiness experiences. Bring together existing programs and new opportunities across skills verification, technical demonstrations, role-based pathways, credentials, and practical application. Decide what to scale, redesign, connect, or retire to keep the portfolio coherent and valuable. Invent new ways for FEs to build and prove expertise. When the field needs a new capability, design the right experience - not automatically another course. This could be a customer scenario, a live technical demonstration, a peer review, a contribution model, an AI-enabled assessment, or something entirely new. Prototype quickly, learn from the field, and scale the strongest ideas. Make readiness relevant to the work FEs actually do. Partner with practitioners, managers, product teams, and SME communities to define credible standards and evidence of capability. Embed development and validation into existing FE workflows wherever possible, making readiness a pull-based experience rather than an additional layer of process. Help the organization adapt to an AI-enabled future. Stay close to how AI is changing FE workflows, technical depth, customer engagement, and delivery models. Ensure our capability models measure judgment, problem-solving, architecture, collaboration, and customer impact - not just static product knowledge. Experiment with AI to improve assessment quality, personalize development, surface expertise, and scale program operations responsibly. Create the systems and signals that make capability visible. Partner with internal platform and engineering teams to turn program concepts into simple, scalable experiences. Ensure that skills, evidence, readiness milestones, and development recommendations are useful to FEs, managers, and leaders in the systems they already use. Build the operating model for a federated technical organization. Establish clear ownership, governance, quality standards, content and assessment lifecycles, and feedback loops across global programs, product SMEs, regional leaders, and enablement partners. Create mechanisms that let expertise scale without centralizing every decision. Drive adoption through influence and strong field experience. Build the narrative, stakeholder plan, manager engagement, and operating rhythm needed to make programs matter. Listen carefully to the field, remove friction, and use adoption data and qualitative feedback to improve the experience. Give leaders a clear view of capability and opportunity. Define meaningful measures of participation, proficiency, capability coverage, readiness, and emerging gaps. Use data to help leaders decide where to invest, where to raise the bar, and how the FE organization is evolving. Connect capability to growth and career opportunities. Partner with FE leadership, HR, and career architecture owners to make demonstrated capability useful in development conversations, specialization paths, succession planning, and career progression where appropriate. What Success Looks Like In your first year, you will have: Established a compelling, shared point of view on what FE capability and readiness need to look like in an AI-enabled Databricks. Created a clear roadmap for the field capability portfolio, with explicit priorities and decisions about what to scale, improve, or stop. Launched or materially evolved high-value readiness experiences that FEs and managers see as relevant to their work - not administrative requirements. Built strong partnerships across FE leadership, product and technical communities, regional teams, HR, and internal platform teams. Given leaders and managers better visibility into capability, gaps, and trends - and helped them act on those signals. Established a scalable operating model that enables expertise to grow across the organization without creating unnecessary central processes. Demonstrated measurable progress in adoption, capability coverage, field confidence, or other outcomes that matter to the business. What We're Looking For 6+ years of experience in technical enablement, product management, learning and development, consulting, field engineering, or program leadership within a high-growth technology company. A track record of building and scaling something new from ambiguity. You have shaped the strategy, aligned stakeholders, designed the experience, launched it, measured it, and improved it over time. Strong strategic judgment and executive presence. You can partner with Directors and VPs to shape priorities, make tradeoffs, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn a broad vision into clear decisions. A product mindset. You start with the user and the problem, test assumptions, design for adoption, and continuously improve the experience based on evidence. The ability to balance rigor with practicality. You know how to create credible standards and meaningful signals without adding unnecessary friction for the field. Strong data fluency. You can define useful measures, interpret dashboards, identify patterns, and use data and field feedback to drive decisions. Experience partnering with internal product, engineering, or platform teams to turn program requirements into scalable tools and workflows. Genuine curiosity about AI and its impact on technical work, customer engagement, and organizational capability. Hands-on experience using AI to improve assessment, personalization, content, or operations is a plus. Enough technical fluency in data and AI to work credibly with technical experts and evaluate whether readiness standards are relevant and meaningful - or the curiosity and learning agility to build that fluency quickly. Excellent communication skills. You can translate between technical practitioners, SME communities, enablement teams, regional leaders, and executive stakeholders. A strong ownership mindset, with the pace, creativity, and judgment to operate effectively in a distributed, cross-functional environment. Nice to Have Experience designing skills taxonomies, competency frameworks, technical certifications, assessment models, or role-based capability systems. Experience building community-driven models for sharing and validating expertise, such as peer review, SME networks, contribution-based credentials, or practitioner communities. Familiarity with learning science, adult learning, assessment design, or evidence-based evaluation. Experience integrating capability or enablement programs with internal platforms, such as skills systems, LMS platforms, CRM systems, or custom enterprise tools. Experience with industry-specific enablement or vertical go-to-market strategies in enterprise software. Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, consulting, technical account management, or data and AI engineering. Why This Role Matters A global FE organization cannot scale its impact through content and training alone. It needs a shared view of what great looks like, practical ways for people to build and demonstrate expertise, strong communities that spread knowledge, and useful signals that help leaders invest in the right capabilities. This role will help build that system for Databricks. You will shape how the FE organization responds to the AI era, make expertise more visible and transferable, and create the conditions for thousands of FEs to grow their impact with customers. The work will be visible, highly cross-functional, and consequential to how Field Engineering operates in the future.
